requirements.title: Quality records use closed versioned schemas
requirements.description: Machine quality records and future runner artifacts have bounded strings, arrays, identifiers, versions, SHAs, and closed object shapes.
acceptance_conditions: Every checked-in quality schema rejects unknown object fields.
Requirement, change, bug, suite, and gate identifiers use their declared namespace regex.
Version, Git SHA, tag object, and path fields are bounded and structurally validated.

requirements.title: Changes and bugs are registered without fixing claims
requirements.description: Every v0.8.3 quality change and known issue has a stable record, evidence vocabulary, reproduction state, severity, impact, and explicit non-fix boundary.
acceptance_conditions: The eight scoped v0.8.3 bugs remain active with resolution_state open-not-fixed or source-fixed-product-pending; none is retired before the required product evidence is complete.
The quality-kernel change covers its own quality, focused-test, and documentation paths.
No source/unit record is promoted to artifact, installed, live, signing, or public evidence.

requirements.title: Release lineage and base selection are explicit
requirements.description: Audit baseline and previous release tag object/peeled commit are checked in; a future run binds candidate SHA in runtime evidence rather than this lineage source.
acceptance_conditions: The previous release records both annotated tag object and peeled commit.
Audit baseline cannot be selected as the release impact base.
PR impact requires an explicit target ref and derives its merge-base; release impact uses the previous peeled commit.

requirements.title: Metadata and impact validation fail closed
requirements.description: The stdlib validator checks schemas, foreign keys, lifecycle rules, dependency cycles, test impact, lineage, production paths, and Git state without accepting arbitrary bases.
acceptance_conditions: Duplicate IDs, bad foreign keys, dependency/replacement cycles, invalid frozen test-impact states, and malformed lineage fail.
Release impact fails on dirty, shallow, non-ancestor, rename/delete, untracked production, or unknown production paths.
Only metadata, impact-pr, and impact-release profiles are accepted by the CLI.

requirements.title: Production paths have quality ownership
requirements.description: Desktop, scripts, test runners and fixtures, build recipes, quality machine files, version sources, release workflows, and operational quality documentation have explicit coverage.
acceptance_conditions: Every changed or untracked production path matches one registered policy prefix or an explicit narrative exemption.
A production path change is covered by an active change record and required source-test gate.
Unknown paths and rename/delete operations fail closed in impact profiles.

basis: read-only Git status and diff inventory

requirements.title: Test entrypoints and gaps are registered
requirements.description: The test catalog records current suite entrypoints, four confirmed orphan entrypoints, four Cargo manifests, runner self-tests, manual states, and future historical escape cases at suite granularity.
acceptance_conditions: The four orphan entrypoints are explicitly present and are not counted as PASS.
All four Cargo.toml manifests are explicitly present.
Manual, legacy, quarantine, and not-yet-automatable entries have owner, reason, expiry, and replacement.

requirements.title: Source-green vocabulary remains layer-specific
requirements.description: Source/unit PASS, legacy known-unreliable gate state, artifact, installed, live, signing, and public claims remain separate vocabulary and are not promoted by this node.
acceptance_conditions: The quality kernel reports source/unit evidence only.
The old S0 test gate remains legacy-known-unreliable until a later node replaces it.
No release-ready, artifact, installed, live, signing, or public claim is emitted by this node.

requirements.title: Focused validation is isolated and reversible
requirements.description: Focused tests use temporary Git repositories or read-only inspection of the current repository and never access credentials, user databases, Science state, installed apps, or other worktrees.
acceptance_conditions: Malicious metadata and Git fixtures fail with stable validator errors.
Focused tests do not modify the real worktree or invoke network, credentials, Science, or installed runtime.
The focused entrypoint is separate from the existing run_all entrypoint.

requirements.title: Trusted exact-catalog source gate is fail closed
requirements.description: A fixed clean exact-HEAD source run binds all fifteen approved suites, exact discovered and executed test identities, observations, existing TestResultV1 records, evidence, and the terminal completion seal without retry or evidence promotion.
acceptance_conditions: GATE-SOURCE selects the exact ordered fifteen-suite source catalog and the public CLI cannot select a subset.
Zero, missing, duplicate, unknown, skipped, ignored, todo, not-run, raw-exit contradiction, retry, drift, or partial authority cannot establish PASS.

The loopback suite builds csswitch-gateway from the bound clean source and offline dependency view into a newly held private target, and its derived binary record must match an independent parent reopen and digest before publication.
RUN-EVIDENCE-GREEN and SOURCE-GREEN remain source/unit claims and require a clean exact-HEAD completion seal.

basis: snapshot-bound gateway driver and parent derived-tool binding

requirements.title: Science check-only and CSSwitch updater boundary
requirements.description: Science check-only behavior, standalone updater artifacts, and DMG-seeded installed-App artifacts remain distinct evidence. The fixed updater path may contain either of the two exact field-observed official executable identifiers; it must require the exact Team ID, fail closed on every other candidate, and commit only the exact same-open SHA-256 snapshot.
acceptance_conditions: Record check-only, standalone updater, and DMG-seed behavior separately.
Require one of the two exact field-observed updater-path identifiers and the exact Team ID without treating embedded metadata as cryptographic provenance.
Bind official_updated selection to a stable same-open SHA-256 content-addressed snapshot and reject unsafe candidates without installed-App fallback.
Prove installed_app selection separately against the DMG seed without mutating the Science data-dir.
Do not promote source checks to installed or live Science proof.

basis: official 0.1.20 and 0.1.25 updater and DMG-seed dual-track source oracles
field App-seeded 0.1.25 executable at the fixed updater path

requirements.title: DeepSeek Pro thinking multi-round contract
requirements.description: DeepSeek Pro thinking multi-round requests must have a separately reproducible request/response contract and must not be treated as fixed by local mock coverage.
acceptance_conditions: Register the HTTP 400 multi-round symptom and its model/adapter boundary.
Keep mock/source evidence separate from provider evidence.
No fixed claim is accepted without the later required provider-layer evidence.

requirements.title: Database access errors have an explicit ownership boundary
requirements.description: Database access errors must identify the owning layer and reproduction boundary before any migration or runtime fix is claimed.
acceptance_conditions: Register database access failures without reading real user databases.
Separate source diagnosis from migration, installed, and live database evidence.
Require a later owner and recovery contract before closure.

requirements.title: GitHub Skill bundle structure compatibility
requirements.description: GitHub Skill bundle archives must distinguish unsupported bundle structure from ordinary install or validation failures.
acceptance_conditions: Register BUNDLE_STRUCTURE_UNSUPPORTED as an open product issue.
Keep archive/fixture evidence separate from public GitHub and installed Skill evidence.
Do not mark the bundle path fixed from a local parser result.

requirements.title: Local stdio MCP Acceptance and HTTPS boundary
requirements.description: Local stdio MCP Acceptance behavior and HTTPS/network boundary must be recorded independently, with local mock evidence never promoted to remote provider proof.
acceptance_conditions: Register the local stdio MCP Acceptance symptom and HTTPS boundary separately.
Keep loopback/local and remote HTTPS claims distinct.
Do not claim live MCP or provider behavior from source-only tests.

requirements.title: OpenCode Go issue 65 compatibility boundary
requirements.description: OpenCode Go issue 65 remains a separately tracked compatibility claim with exact selector, route, and evidence-layer identity.
acceptance_conditions: Register issue 65 with its source paths and expected compatibility suite.
Separate local mock or catalog evidence from live OpenCode Go evidence.
Do not record a fixed route without a later exact provider-layer result.

requirements.title: Science Mach-O metadata acceptance
requirements.description: Science Mach-O metadata must not be incorrectly rejected by the production identity boundary; parser and identity evidence remain separate from signing and installed proof.
acceptance_conditions: Reproduce metadata false-rejection and retain it as source-fixed-product-pending until later evidence layers close.
Require fail-closed parser tests that distinguish malformed, mismatched, and valid metadata.
Do not convert source parser evidence into signing or installed acceptance.

requirements.title: SSH late-failure transaction preserves one serialized authority
requirements.description: System-SSH opt-in performs every prevalidatable check before OAuth mutation, rechecks the exact candidate and prior owned runtime authority inside the lifecycle serializer, and exactly compensates every changed authority after a true late failure.
acceptance_conditions: One operation-scoped Codex proof includes the candidate and any alive owned prior Gateway rollback context; the serialized section rechecks exact child, launch identity, key fingerprint, launch context, Config, and credential authority.
Every SSH config, wrapper, sandbox authority, and managed-stub check that can be completed early runs before OAuth mutation.
A true late failure exactly compensates OAuth, active profile, Gateway, Science, managed stub including a pre-existing managed V2 file, transaction journal, and durable cleanup state.
Foreign SSH state remains unchanged, retry is idempotent, and diagnostics contain only typed credential-free safe codes.
The same authority and compensation contract is exercised again by the final isolated production artifact runtime before release closure.

basis: source red-green-mutation contract and fresh dual final review

requirements.title: Tool arguments preserve the original input-schema contract
requirements.description: CSSwitch must attribute mutually exclusive tool arguments to the exact schema, reducer, or upstream-output boundary and must not forward already-invalid arguments or guess which field to remove.
acceptance_conditions: A fixed original schema and fixtures independently cover pre-upstream schema conversion, stream/done reduction, and already-invalid upstream output.
CSSwitch-originated corruption is repaired only at the responsible seam while the test schema and oracle remain unchanged.
Already-invalid upstream arguments are rejected before Science execution with a bounded typed protocol error and no heuristic field deletion.
A mutation that reintroduces the same seam defect produces the same declared failure identity.

requirements.title: Science reattachment and stop bind managed runtime identity
requirements.description: Desktop restart may adopt a running Science only when executable fingerprint, isolated data-dir, unique listener PID/process-start, and managed launch identity agree. Stop success additionally requires final configured-port closure and atomic no-clobber receipt cleanup.
acceptance_conditions: An exact managed-runtime fixture reattaches without starting a duplicate Science process.
Unknown listener, executable replacement, duplicate listener, and PID race each fail closed.
Mismatch paths send no signal and preserve the foreign or changed process.
A false-to-true final port observation or missing data-dir with a live listener cannot publish confirmed-stopped.
Concurrent receipt creation wins atomically and preserves the old tombstone without overwrite.
The same identity rules are exercised again by the final isolated production artifact runtime.

requirements.title: Gateway external exit has accurate bounded recovery
requirements.description: An externally terminated owned Gateway must become an accurate failed state and may be restarted at most once only while configuration generation and runtime identity remain unchanged.
acceptance_conditions: Owned-child exit produces a Gateway-specific failure instead of an authentication or permission error.
Exactly one automatic recovery is allowed when generation, executable identity, ownership, and path-secret identity are unchanged.
Generation drift, identity drift, or a second exit produces an actionable manual recovery state and no retry loop.
Profile, transaction journal, persistent state, and path secret do not drift across failed or successful recovery.

requirements.title: OpenAI Responses v0.8.3 core compatibility
requirements.description: The blocking Responses scope is limited to basic text, two-turn continuity, and function call/result, with protocol conformance and provider/model compatibility recorded independently.
acceptance_conditions: Fixed local protocol fixtures independently pass text, two-turn continuity, and function call/result.
Each provider/model row records its own adapter and model mapping and is not inferred from generic protocol conformance.
Images, proprietary reasoning, native streaming, and structured output neither block nor establish this gate.
A current-target row that cannot reproduce a defect receives no product modification.
